INTRAMUROS FIRE AFTERMATH

LOOK: Remnants of houses stand after a fire razed a residential area in Intramuros, Manila on Wednesday afternoon, Feb. 25.

The fire was declared under control by 8:32 p.m., with an estimated 532 families evacuated after the incident, according to the Manila City Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Department. | 📸: Manila PIO
